label: An actual CAUSE_2 of esse between actual CONCRETE_6 individuals grounds it at w
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred, the weak version of cb1cdea9: at the selected world w, if c and x are both concrete and exist at w, c is distinct from x and c causes the esse of x (CausesIn c x esse, CAUSE_2), then c grounds x under the selected relation at w. Unlike cb1cdea9 it does not conclude that the cause is concrete or exists at w; it assumes both. So the scope condition on cb1cdea9 (a world-free, tenseless cause of being absent at w, such as an originating cause or cause of coming to be, row 14 of causal-dependence-support-investigation.md (e)) does not touch it. It still identifies a distinct cause of esse between actual concreta as a grounding step, which presupposes reading the selected relation as existential grounding of those concreta.
